newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Koc Hldg buys local shipping firm for $7.4 ml.
newsitem.headline: Turk Koc Hldg buys local shipping firm for $7.4 ml.

text.p: Turkey's leading industrial conglomerate Koc Holding said it bought a 90 percent stake in a local shipping firm for $7.36 million.

"According to the executive board's decision, shipbuilding and maritime transport company PKM's 90 percent stake, having 7.11 billion lira nominal value, was bought for $7,359,599 from Profilo group," Koc said a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
It said vessel and yacht building activities would be carried out at PKM's shipyard based in Ayandere on the outskirts of Istanbul and by the Marmara Sea.
